# Fells

> Fells sells access to Anthropic's original Claude models through a Token Plan and group-buy seats. One API key works in Claude Code and compatible tools. Fells does not run coding-agent sessions.

Prices below are the ones printed on the site. The homepage and the checkout page say to contact online support to confirm available services, prices and payment arrangements. Where the site does not state a number, this file leaves it out.

Official price comparisons on the site use US$1 = ¥7.

## Models

Per 1M tokens, in USD. The pay-as-you-go block on the homepage is labeled "Coming soon". Struck-through figures are the official API list prices shown on the site. Only these Anthropic models are listed as live.

- Claude Opus 5.5: input $2.00 (official $4.00), output $10.00 (official $20.00)
- Claude Sonnet 5.5: input $1.00 (official $2.00), output $5.00 (official $10.00)
- Claude Fable 5.1: input $5.00 (official $10.00), output $25.00 (official $50.00)
- Claude Haiku 5.5: input $0.05 (official $0.10), output $0.25 (official $0.50). Prompts over 100K tokens: input $0.25 (official $0.50), output $1.25 (official $2.50)

The site also names Fable 5.5 as rolling out. It does not list a separate price for Fable 5.5.

## Trial

Trial Pack: ¥99, one time, for $100 of Claude quota counted at official API list prices. The page shows ¥700 as the official comparison for that quota. New users, once per account. The site does not say how many days the trial quota stays valid.

## Token Plan

A monthly quota in US dollars at official API list prices. No 5-hour window. Guaranteed quota is always available; past it, usage can continue while capacity is free, up to the monthly maximum. Quota resets each month and does not roll over.

- Token Plan 1000: ¥1,288 / month, $1,000 guaranteed, up to $2,000. Official comparison shown: ¥7,000.
- Token Plan 2000: ¥2,288 / month, $2,000 guaranteed, up to $4,000. Official comparison shown: ¥14,000.
- Token Plan 4000: ¥3,988 / month, $4,000 guaranteed, up to $8,000. Official comparison shown: ¥28,000.

## Group buy

A share of one official Claude Max 20× subscription. Seats keep that subscription's 5-hour window and weekly limit, split by seat size. Your own Fells account and key; no shared login.

- 5× seat: ¥1,288 / month, 1/4 of a Max 20×. The site prices the same allowance from Anthropic at $100.
- 10× seat: ¥2,288 / month, 1/2 of a Max 20×. The site prices the same allowance from Anthropic at $200.

## Payment options

What the live pages say:

- Homepage plan cards and the checkout page: contact online support to confirm available services, prices and payment arrangements. Plan cards do not link to a self-serve checkout.
- FAQ: pay with Alipay on this site, or order from the Taobao or Xianyu shop. A shop order is delivered as a CDK, a one-time code, and entered on the checkout page under Redeem CDK.
- Referral, from the homepage: you and the friend you refer each get ¥100.

## Claude Code setup

Homepage example:

```
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://api.fells.dev/anthropic"
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="fls_live_••••••••"
claude
```

Developer API page, saved at `~/.claude/settings.json`. Replace `<your-api-key>` with the key from the Fells developer API panel:

```
{
  "env": {
    "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": "https://api.fells.dev/anthropic",
    "ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN": "<your-api-key>",
    "ANTHROPIC_MODEL": "claude-opus-5-5"
  }
}
```

Install commands listed on that page: `curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash`, `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`, `brew install --cask claude-code`.

If you were signed in to an Anthropic account, run `/logout` in Claude Code first. Then run `/model` to choose Opus 5.5 or Sonnet 5.5.

The homepage also lists these endpoints: `/anthropic/v1/messages`, `/openai/v1/responses`, `/openai/v1/chat/completions`.

## Pages

Blog posts are listed on the blog page. They do not have individual URLs.

- [Home](https://fells.dev/): Token Plan, group buy, model prices, API
- [Pricing](https://fells.dev/market/): plans and pay-as-you-go channels
- [Developer API](https://fells.dev/developer-api/): Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode setup
- [API key security](https://fells.dev/security/): create, store and revoke keys
- [FAQ](https://fells.dev/faq/): Token Plan, group buy, CDK, API keys
- [Blog](https://fells.dev/blog/): index only

## 简体中文

Fells 提供 Anthropic 原版 Claude 模型的 Token Plan 和拼团席位。一个 API Key 可用于 Claude Code 和兼容工具。Fells 不运行编程 Agent 会话。

以下价格都是网站上印出的数字。首页和结算页写明：可购买的服务、价格和付款安排请联系在线客服确认。网站没有写出的数字，这里也不写。

官网价对照按 1 美元 = 7 元人民币。

### 模型

单位是每百万 token 的美元价。首页按量付费一节标为「即将推出」。划线价是页面上的官方 API 标价。目前列出的在售模型只有这些 Anthropic 模型。

- Claude Opus 5.5：输入 $2.00（官方 $4.00），输出 $10.00（官方 $20.00）
- Claude Sonnet 5.5：输入 $1.00（官方 $2.00），输出 $5.00（官方 $10.00）
- Claude Fable 5.1：输入 $5.00（官方 $10.00），输出 $25.00（官方 $50.00）
- Claude Haiku 5.5：输入 $0.05（官方 $0.10），输出 $0.25（官方 $0.50）。提示超过 100K token：输入 $0.25（官方 $0.50），输出 $1.25（官方 $2.50）

页面还提到 Fable 5.5 正在灰度。没有单独标出 Fable 5.5 的价格。

### 体验包

体验包：¥99，一次性，$100 Claude 额度（按官方 API 标价计）。页面上同等用量的官方对照价是 ¥700。新用户，每个账号一次。网站没有写明体验额度有效多少天。

### Token Plan

按官方 API 标价、以美元计的月度额度。没有 5 小时限制。保障额度随时可用；超出之后，容量有空闲就可以继续用，直到月度上限。额度每月重置，不结转。

- Token Plan 1000：¥1,288 / 月，保障 $1,000，最高 $2,000。页面上的官方对照价是 ¥7,000。
- Token Plan 2000：¥2,288 / 月，保障 $2,000，最高 $4,000。页面上的官方对照价是 ¥14,000。
- Token Plan 4000：¥3,988 / 月，保障 $4,000，最高 $8,000。页面上的官方对照价是 ¥28,000。

### 拼团

一份官方 Claude Max 20× 订阅拆成席位。席位保留该订阅的 5 小时窗口和每周限额，按席位大小分成。独立的 Fells 账号和 Key，不共享登录。

- 5× 席位：¥1,288 / 月，Max 20× 的 1/4。网站把同等用量的 Anthropic 价格标为 $100。
- 10× 席位：¥2,288 / 月，Max 20× 的 1/2。网站把同等用量的 Anthropic 价格标为 $200。

### 付款方式

页面上实际写的是：

- 首页套餐卡片和结算页：联系在线客服确认可购买的服务、价格和付款安排。套餐卡片不链到自助结算。
- 常见问题：可以在本站用支付宝付款，也可以在淘宝店或闲鱼店下单。店铺订单会发给你一个 CDK（一次性兑换码），在结算页的「兑换 CDK」里输入。
- 首页推荐：你和被邀请的好友各得 ¥100。

### Claude Code 配置

首页示例：

```
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://api.fells.dev/anthropic"
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="fls_live_••••••••"
claude
```

开发者 API 页，写入 `~/.claude/settings.json`。把 `<your-api-key>` 换成 Fells 开发者 API 面板里的 Key：

```
{
  "env": {
    "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": "https://api.fells.dev/anthropic",
    "ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN": "<your-api-key>",
    "ANTHROPIC_MODEL": "claude-opus-5-5"
  }
}
```

该页列出的安装命令：`curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash`、`npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`、`brew install --cask claude-code`。

如果登录过 Anthropic 账号，先在 Claude Code 里运行 `/logout`，再运行 `/model` 选择 Opus 5.5 或 Sonnet 5.5。

首页还列出这些端点：`/anthropic/v1/messages`、`/openai/v1/responses`、`/openai/v1/chat/completions`。

- [常见问题](https://fells.dev/zh/faq/)：Token Plan、拼团、CDK、API Key
- [博客](https://fells.dev/zh/blog/)：仅索引页
